Class MKPressedTracker

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.MKPressedTracker
public final class MKPressedTracker extends Object
ACCEPTED aesthetic-only exception to §0019 (see MKVanillaButtonPressedMixin class javadoc for the full carve-out rationale).

Shared press-state tracker for the "vanilla-style pressed-visual on every clickable" exploration. Used by:

  • MKVanillaButtonPressedMixin — tracks press on vanilla AbstractButton instances
  • MKYaclWidgetPressedMixin — tracks press on YACL AbstractWidget instances (when YACL is loaded; silently skips otherwise via @Pseudo)
  • MKYaclControllerOverlayMixin — reads the press state at render time on YACL ControllerWidget instances

Why a shared tracker

Mixin's @Unique fields are per-mixin-target. The vanilla button mixin can hold its field on AbstractButton. The YACL case needs press tracking on YACL's AbstractWidget but render-overlay on its ControllerWidget subclass — different target classes, can't share a @Unique field. A WeakHashMap-based external tracker sidesteps that with a single source of truth.

WeakHashMap semantics

Keyed by widget instance (Object reference). Weak keys mean closing a screen and letting widgets be GC'd naturally evicts entries — no per-screen cleanup needed. isPressedAndCheckRelease(Object) polls GLFW once per call and auto-clears the entire map when the mouse button is released, so stale entries from edge cases (release-off-widget, screen-swap-mid-press) drain on the next query.

  • Method Details

    • markPressed

      public static void markPressed(Object widget)
      Records that a click has been received on the given widget. Called from a mixin's TAIL on the widget's click-handling method (typically when the method returns true / claims the click).

    • clearPressed

      public static void clearPressed(Object widget)
      Removes a widget's pressed-state entry. Called from a mixin's mouseReleased hook for explicit release tracking (the lazy GLFW-poll cleanup in isPressedAndCheckRelease(Object) also handles this, but the explicit removal is cleaner when the release event is available).

    • isPressedAndCheckRelease

      public static boolean isPressedAndCheckRelease(Object widget)
      Returns true if the widget is currently in the pressed-state map AND the left mouse button is still held (per GLFW poll). Side effect: if GLFW reports the button released, clears the entire PRESSED map — drains stale entries from edge cases like release-off-widget or screen-swap-mid-press.
